questions.title: Thread-Safe Builder Pattern (running two threads on it)
questions.body: SDE/SSE-2 Round 2 (LeetCode Discuss Oct 2024). Implement Builder pattern, spin up 2 threads running it. Key: synchronized is blocking — use AtomicReference or make builder immutable (each .withX() returns new builder).
questions.answer: Immutable builder approach: each setter returns a new builder with the updated field. Thread-safe because no shared mutable state. For mutable: use AtomicReference on the final object.
questions.hint: Immutable builder approach: each setter returns a new builder with the updated field. Thread-safe because no shared mutable state. For mutable: use AtomicReference<T> on the final object.
